newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise seven bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise seven bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued certificates of deposit dated September 13 to commercial banks worth seven billion Lebanese pounds compared with four billion pounds last week.
The bank sold 60-day CDs worth seven billion compared with four billion last week. There were no sales of 45-day CDs for the second week running.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.75 precent and 13.50 percent respectively, unchanged from last week.
